description.value: Hokkaido Ramen Santouka is a Japanese ramen chain originating from Hokkaido, Japan, with this Richmond location serving its signature white tonkotsu-based broths in shio, shoyu, miso, and kara-miso styles. The menu centres on slow-cooked pork — particularly the ToKusen Toroniku featuring melt-in-your-mouth pork cheek — alongside a dedicated vegetarian ramen made with soy milk and white miso. Cycling through Richmond's suburban grid, a touring rider will find this a reliable stop for a hot, restorative bowl with a broad menu that accommodates different dietary needs.
